title: Teen Patti Guru: Which App Does the Name Refer To?
excerpt: Teen Patti Guru has been used by more than one app, and none is listed on Google Play today. What we checked, and how to verify any Teen Patti Guru APK.
content:
**Short answer:** "Teen Patti Guru" is not one app. The name has been used by at least two different Android packages in the past, and on 28 September 2026 neither was listed on Google Play. A Google Play search for "teen patti guru" in India showed no app with that exact name. Any "Teen Patti Guru APK" you find today comes from a website, not the Play Store, so check it carefully.

This article records what we checked and when. It is not a recommendation to install or play any app. Online money games are prohibited in India under the Online Gaming Act, 2025 (see our [online gaming laws guide](/blog/online-gaming-laws-in-india-what-players-should-know)). 18+ only.

## What We Found (Checked 28 September 2026)

| Package | Google Play status |
|---|---|
| com.arecagame.teenpatti | Not listed (Play returns "Not found") |
| com.Teenpatti.Guruaaa | Not listed (Play returns "Not found") |
| Google Play search, "teen patti guru" (India) | No app with that name in the results |

Search suggestions such as "teen patti guru pro" show people are looking for newer versions, but we found no store listing for one.

## A Note on This Site's Own Listing

AllYonoGuru's [Teen Patti Guru](/teen-patti-guru) listing currently links to a Yono-network download domain, not to either package above. The version number shown on that listing has not been independently verified. We are reviewing it under our [editorial policy](/editorial-policy).

## Why the Name Keeps Reappearing

"Teen Patti" is a generic game name, and "Guru" is a common add-on. When an app leaves the Play Store, its name often lives on through APK download sites and new apps that reuse it. The same happens with [Rummy Guru](/blog/rummy-guru-which-app-is-it), which several unrelated apps use.

## How to Check Any Teen Patti Guru APK

- **Find the package name** (Settings → Apps → the app → App details) and compare it with the table above.
- **Check who publishes it.** A download page with no named developer tells you nothing about who runs the app.
- **Look at the file name** before installing; a file named after another brand is a warning sign.
- **Review the permissions** it asks for. See [Android app permissions before you install](/blog/understanding-android-app-permissions-before-you-install).
- **Never pay an "unlock" or "withdrawal" fee**, and never share an OTP or UPI PIN.

If you have lost money to a fake app, call **1930** or report at cybercrime.gov.in. See [Responsible Gaming](/responsible-gaming) for more help.

## Learn Teen Patti Itself

The game's rules do not depend on the app. Start with [Teen Patti hand ranking and sequence order](/blog/teen-patti-hand-ranking-and-sequence-order) and the [complete 3 Patti rules](/blog/3-patti-rules-complete-guide), then the [AK47](/blog/ak47-teen-patti-rules) and [Muflis](/blog/muflis-teen-patti-rules) variations.
